decisionRationale: The repository gate has deterministic operational data, but no live provider quality, monetary cost, or macOS Chibi data. Promotion is bounded until those measurements are captured with the same fixture and model family.

unavailableMeasurements.name: ordinary-positronic-analysis
unavailableMeasurements.reason: requires provider credentials and a stable live model configuration; excluded from the deterministic repository gate

unavailableMeasurements.name: ordinary-positronic-bounded-retrieval
unavailableMeasurements.reason: no bounded-retrieval implementation exists in the current product; this comparison remains a follow-up experiment

unavailableMeasurements.name: live-answer-quality-and-cost
unavailableMeasurements.reason: not measurable without provider credentials, a fixed model family, and an approved evaluation corpus

unavailableMeasurements.name: macos-chibi-packaging
unavailableMeasurements.reason: Chibi is Linux-only in the pinned build and macOS evidence is deferred by issue #181

unavailableMeasurements.name: generated-cell-repair-rate
unavailableMeasurements.reason: the fixture uses a fixed valid cell and does not measure root-model repair attempts; this remains a follow-up under issue #181

unavailableMeasurements.name: malicious-program-safety
unavailableMeasurements.reason: worker conformance and malicious-program suites are owned by issues #178 and #179; this benchmark does not replay or aggregate those fixtures

unavailableMeasurements.name: heap-and-loop-containment
unavailableMeasurements.reason: worker limits and containment suites are covered by issues #178 and #179, while this short fixture records no stress distribution or heap profile
